title: Error Taxonomy ScoutGraph — taxonomy-first debugging lens for Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a taxonomy-first error exploration surface (ScoutGraph) inside Redwood Console that helps engineers navigate, triage, and debug failed requests at scale. The ScoutGraph blends a collapsible hierarchical taxonomy of error classes with a timeline of representative requests and a live payload inspector. Objective: reduce mean time to triage (MTTT) by making error classes discoverable, surfacing likely root causes, and directly linking to rollout/traffic controls and cost signal views.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma screens for ScoutGraph list view, cluster view, and payload inspector
Prototype that can simulate: expanding taxonomy nodes, filtering by timeframe/route/model, and opening a request payload side panel
Design spec documenting states: empty, low-volume, high-cardinality (many unique errors), and post-retry collapse
Interaction flow linking an error node to: (a) sample requests, (b) rollout controls (canary/abort), and (c) token-cost impact estimate
Accessibility checklist completed (keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels for tree nodes, contrast)
